questions.question_text: $PT$ and $PQ$ are tangents to a circle, centre $O$. The smaller angle $\angle TOQ = 136^{\circ}$. Find $\angle TPQ$.

options.why: Copied the centre angle instead of subtracting it from $180^{\circ}$.
Halved $180^{\circ}-136^{\circ}=44^{\circ}$, giving half the angle between the tangents.
Subtracted $136^{\circ}$ from $360^{\circ}$ but forgot the two tangent-radius right angles.

$\angle TPQ = 44^{\circ}$
